paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra, beginning of chapter 6: Rabbi La in the name of Rabbi Elazar, Rabbi Yasa in the name of the Rabbis — “who went in and heard from the study house of Bar Itayin,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 6:1 fully writes Rabbi La in Rabbi Lazar’s name and Rabbi Yasa in the name of the rabbis who entered and heard from Bar Itayin’s study house. This supports the contextual Elazar expansion and the relative-clause parsing, without identifying a canonical person.
The statements are reports from the study house, not an additional biographical identification of Bar Itayin.
